The 2010 Italian Grand Prix (round 14, held at Autodromo Nazionale di Monza on 12 September 2010) was won by Fernando Alonso driving for Ferrari. He started from pole, with Jenson Button (McLaren) second and Felipe Massa (Ferrari) third.

ANSWER: Fernando Alonso
